name: Andaz Seoul Gangnam
positioning: Andaz hotel in Seoul's Gangnam district, directly connected to Apgujeong Metro Station, with guestroom interiors inspired by Bojagi, the traditional Korean patchwork weaving art
best_for: Travelers who want a Gangnam base a short walk from Apgujeong and Cheongdam
Guests who want high-floor rooms or suites with views of Gangnam and Seoul

facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from the Apgujeong and Cheongdam neighborhoods, with Korean luxury fashion and beauty, art museums and dining.
The hotel's interiors are filled with original art and have views of Gangnam.
Standard King rooms have a diagonal wall that subtly divides the space.
Rooms include a complimentary minibar with snacks, non-alcoholic beverages and beer.
Premium rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows and a bathroom with a deep soaking tub and rain shower, and can be converted into a family room.
The Sky Terrace Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows, a private terrace and a dining area with a bar.
The Garden Suite is on the 3rd floor, with garden views and a multimedia experience in the living area.
The Summer House includes an indoor pool and fitness center.
The hotel's spa is Ocelas Spa, part of The Summer House.
Meat & Co. Steakhouse grills local Hanwoo and American beef in a Pira charcoal oven.

highlights.text: Guestroom interiors, artwork and amenities are inspired by Bojagi, the traditional Korean patchwork weaving art.
The hotel is directly connected to Apgujeong Metro Station in Seoul.
The Gangnam Penthouse has a theater sound system, a circular deep soaking tub overlooking the Han River and Seoul, and an expansive outdoor terrace.
High Floor rooms are on the 10th floor and above, with unobstructed views of Gangnam.
Jogakbo, inspired by Apgujeong Gourmet Alley, has three interactive dining zones: Bites & Wine, Jogakbo Kitchen and Meat & Co. Steakhouse.

considerations.text: Standard King and Twin rooms have a rain shower and no deep soaking tub.
Incheon International Airport is 65 kilometers from the hotel.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
